Name: Witch NPC
Author: Billybob8000
Description:
[center]Adds a new NPC Esmerelda the Witch! The ex-wife of the Wizard is now in Stardew Valley. With a backstory and magical personality she fits right in with the Vanilla game. Comes with complete dialogue, schedule, and events!


[b][u]Gifts[/u][/b]
Loves: Jade, Midnight Carp, Oil of Garlic, Life [size=2]Elixir, Strange Bun, Void Salmon, Tea Leaves[/size]
Likes: Ancient Doll, Strange Doll (Yellow), Strange Doll (Green), Pumpkin, Holly, Hops, Red Mushroom, Mead, Bat Wing
Neutral: Animal Products, Artisan Goods, And Most Gems
Dislikes: Wild Horseradish, Cave Carrot, Cactus Fruit, Void Egg, Void [size=2]Mayonnaise[/size]
Hates: Quartz, Super Cucumber, Purple Mushroom, Void Essence, Solar Essence
﻿
[b][u]﻿Heart Events
[/u][/b]2 Heart Event: Witch's Swamp
[size=2]4 Heart Event: In the Mountains - 9:00pm - 2:00am - Must be raining[/size]
6 Heart Event: Witch's Hut
8 Heart Event: Witch's Hut
10 Heart Event: Railroad - 3:00pm - 7:00pm
[size=5]
[/size][b][u]Upcoming Updates
[/u][/b]Quests, Potions, Deeper Events, And More!
